items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: He was a guy named Dave, Dave, Dave, Dave, Riley, Dave Sutton. He used to be a gangster. But then how he had the swing land in Chicago.

ctx.x: I see. Well, that gives me a rough idea. Yeah. You know, I like to get the dates on it, roughly.

Now, there's one thing I've never told you about. He had a fellow named Leonard Reed. I don't know if you've ever heard of him. Can't place him now. Well, he's a show producer. He used to be a tap dancer a long time ago. Real light boy. But he got up on one of the best shows in Chicago ever was known. He was a guy named Dave, Dave, Dave, Dave, Riley, Dave Sutton. He used to be a gangster. But then how he had the swing land in Chicago. And he thought more Leonard Reed needed his own son. Leonard Reed wasn't no kin…
Well, this must have been a while back.
